items.author: deejayrana
items.quote: Bayonetta ha recibido a menudo el apelativo de Devil May Cry con protagonista femenina, y no es casualidad: el juego busca activamente esa comparación. Hereda gran parte del sistema de combate de la saga DMC y lo traslada a una generación más centrada en el espectáculo que en la experimentación mecánica. Aquí Bayonetta se ve mejor de lo que se juega, pero lo que se ve es realmente espectacular. La edición de Xbox 360 cuenta con unas características de sistema que permiten que ese show funcione con fluidez, y eso es clave: el juego se sostiene en la grandilocuencia, en la velocidad, en la acumulación de estímulos. Aunque el sistema de combos no es tan profundo como aparenta —depende en exceso de la evasión, la movilidad y de evitar el daño—, el espectáculo resulta lo suficientemente sólido como para justificar la experiencia. Es un acierto parcial: no tanto por su profundidad mecánica, sino por cómo convierte el exceso visual en su principal lenguaje.

items.author: Trishi
items.quote:
Having played Bayonetta on the PS3, Xbox 360, and PC, with the most time spent on the Xbox 360, I can confidently say that this game stands as the best in the series. While the PS3 version suffered from notably slow loading times, the overall experience on the Xbox 360 was exceptional. Nowadays I prefer the Steam version. 
Bayonetta offers a thrilling gameplay experience that is challenging and rewarding. The combat mechanics are finely tuned, allowing for a seamless blend of combos and special moves. This game demands skill and precision, making every encounter feel engaging and intense. The focus on gameplay is evident, providing a rich and varied action experience that keeps players coming back for more.
The soundtrack of Bayonetta is nothing short of fantastic, perfectly complementing the high-octane action with memorable tracks that enhance the overall atmosphere. Coupled with interesting levels, the game creates a vibrant world filled with diverse environments.
Bayonetta serves as a clear climax of the series, showcasing everything that makes it great. The variety in gameplay keeps each level feeling fresh, whether you're battling angels or engaging in epic boss fights. 
As one of my favorite games of all time, Bayonetta has left a lasting impression on me. Its combination of superb gameplay, captivating music, and unique design elements make it a standout title in the action genre. For fans of challenging and stylish combat games, Bayonetta is an absolute must-play. It is also way faster than games like DMC.

items.author: Akira_The_Kat
items.quote: Bayonetta is one of the best action games of the seventh generation. With an in depth combo system, catchy soundtrack, and non stop over the top action, Bayonetta still holds up a decade later. Bayonetta follows the bewitching witch of the same name, as she goes on an adventure to find out more about her forgotten past. Encountering wild and wacky characters as the game goes on, each topping the last. Bayonetta will top your expectations and make you grin and chuckle at the absurdity of it all. The gameplay consist of punching, kicking, and slicing your way through the countless hoards of angels sent on a witch hunt after Bayonetta to put a stop to her. What makes her stand out from the rest of the action characters of the genre is her ability to slow down time with a well timed press of the trigger, allowing you to preform combos just as flashy and beautiful as the lovely witch herself.  The combo system is very friendly to newcomers of the genre, but offers enough there for those treading familiar grounds. It features a combo ranking system similar to that seen in the Devil May Cry franchise. The game also has a lot of content to unlock, as was expected this generation. An unlockable difficultly mode, new characters, secret boss fights, and plenty of items and costumes to buy, it'll definitely keep you busy if you're looking for a game with things to do. I'm personally about 30 hours in (at the time of this review) and on my third playthrough and I still haven't unlocked all the characters and secret boss. Aside from all the action, there are segments where Bayonetta may drive a motorcycle or even a giant missile. The games soundtrack is very catchy, the games main battle theme is "Fly Me To The Moon" but remixed to be very fast paced to match the action. It's a joy to listen to while playing. And the graphics of the game hold up pretty well, not the best looking game of last generation, but nothing looks too blocky or jaggy. The games art style doesn't make the characters extremely realistic, and the color palette is pretty varied compared to the abundance of gray and brown we saw that generation. Characters consist of bright and vibrant colors that stand out from the, ironically, gray and brown backgrounds. But overall Bayonetta is definitely a game that is still worth a play a decade later. It is and probably will be one of my favorite action games of all time.

items.author: Alex_Pilgrim008
items.quote: This is one of the great action games made for the Xbox 360. It's an epic masterpiece that is an equal to "God of War III" in every way. Campy, bizarre and over-the-top, "Bayonetta" is a visual stunner that builds upon the combat of "Devil May Cry". The story might be convoluted, but the gameplay is top-notch. Fighting is fast, fluid and flashy. There are also moments that recall Sega classics such as "Sonic The Hedgehog" and "Space Harrier". While the game may not be for everyone due to the sexual references and anime-like weirdness, it still packs quite a wallop. So if you're a fan of Dante, Kratos and Ryu Hayabusa, then you'll love Bayonetta. I would rate it with a 9.3 out of 10.
